pkgmetadata.longdescription: Brave Origin is a standalone edition of the Brave web browser that strips out Brave Rewards, Brave Wallet, the built-in AI assistant Leo, and other Web3/crypto features, keeping only the core privacy and ad/tracker blocking (Brave Shields). It is built on the same Chromium codebase as regular Brave.

use.flag: Verify the release checksum using Brave's OpenPGP signature
